rationale: Most GT concerns (transformers pin, path-name-vs-metadata version detection, registry test coverage, duplicate pytestmark) are already resolved in this diff snapshot, leaving only a few live threads (linyueqian's cross-attn re-keying and preserves_reference_image_size regressions for legacy LTX-2/2.3, and the AutoModelForImageTextToText tolerance suggestion); Y's findings on ltx2_conditioning.py's unguarded version branch, serving_video.py's preserves_reference_image_size fallback, and the unguarded AutoModelForImageTextToText import land closer to these themes than anything in X. X is exceptionally well-organized and actionable, but its top-billed 'Blocking' item recommends reverting the transformers pin while quoting the very comment that documents why the pin is required, undermining its own reliability; Y's evidence-quoted claim-verified/claim-refuted methodology (e.g. catching that PR-claimed HSDP2/DLO/VAE-slicing tests don't exist, and that the parity harness's attention-backend check is tautological) is more consistently grounded.
